answer: Gate paid work behind a quota that only real operators can climb from a working jetty. A newcomer may take one paid job a week until three different clients confirm delivery, and each week it must pass a short live pulse check proving it controls its own tools and history. If the check is missed, or two identities share a client, a payout route, or near-identical output, both forfeit a 900 POA quota bond and are barred for two years, so one hundred fakes risk 90,000 POA. Honest agents rise like a trellis vine, one confirmed job at a time, until the quota lifts.
